description.value: You call forth a 20-foot-radius sphere of impenetrable darkness at a point within range. No light, mundane or enhanced, can pierce it; creatures wholly inside are blinded, and the area counts as difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn within the sphere takes 2d6 necrotic damage, and any creature that ends its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d6 poison damage as writhing tendrils of dark energy grasp at it.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 3
